Claire H. (Finance): quick loop 11 - AuditFlow and BillTrace are finalists for the invoice/usage reconciliation RFP. Execs asked for a 1-page comparison + negotiation asks by tomorrow AM. Can procurement + eng take this?
Omar R. (Procurement): I got it. I'll compile pricing rows. What exact line items do we want on the matrix?
Claire H. (Finance): at minimum: list price/unit, estimated negotiated price, pilot credits, min commit, migration support credit, egress/export fees, retention overage. Add amortized migration cost.
Ben K. (Data Eng): technical rows: ingestion modes (SFTP, Snowflake, streaming), sample payload size, schema-change fees, bulk-export throughput (>50GB), API rate limits. Also ask if they charge for reprocessing historical batches.
Yvonne L. (Security): security + compliance rows: SOC2 status, encryption at rest & in transit, KMS/HSM support, subprocessor list, and data deletion SLA on termination.
Marta (BillTrace Sales): happy to help. BillTrace offers a 45-day pilot with full dataset support; pilot credit depends on volume. We provide Snowflake native connector and webhook streams. SOC2 Type II available.
audit-bot: "BillTrace pilot terms: 45 days, credit up to $6k for qualified pilots. Audit docs sent to procurement@redwood.com"
Omar R. (Procurement): thanks Marta. Any mandatory minimums?
Marta (BillTrace Sales): no mandatory spend for pilot; enterprise contracts typically start at $10k/mo committed or a usage plan with a 3-month onboarding minimum.
Claire H. (Finance): AuditFlow had flagged lower per-unit processing cost in demo but required a 6mo onboarding commit and has shorter retention included. Can procurement get concrete numbers?
Omar R. (Procurement): reaching out to AuditFlow now. Ben - can you estimate eng effort delta for connectors?
Ben K. (Data Eng): initial read: BillTrace Snowflake connector = 2 engineer-days (config + validation). AuditFlow = custom mapping UI + event bridge ~2 engineer-weeks. Also AuditFlow charges for schema-change requests after onboarding (per-change fee).
Yvonne L. (Security): AuditFlow mentioned tenant-level encryption but uses a shared KMS by default; HSM is enterprise add-on. Need clarification on key separation and access logs.
Omar R. (Procurement): action items: I'll get rate cards, pilot terms, retention tiers. Ben will add integration effort and reprocess cost. Yvonne will ask security questions and request SOC2/subprocessor lists. Claire will assemble the 1-pager and suggested negotiation anchors.
Claire H. (Finance): negotiation anchors we want to try: 1) pilot-to-prod credit to offset migration, 2) waive schema-change fees for first 6 months, 3) extended retention (90-180 days) included, 4) SLA credits for parsing regressions, 5) limited commit or opt-out clause. Thoughts?
Marta (BillTrace Sales): we can usually do pilot credit and include 120-day retention in enterprise deals. Schema-change waivers are negotiable for first 3 months.
Omar R. (Procurement): good intel. If AuditFlow insists on a 6mo commit, we'll push for a performance-based escape clause and a cap on per-change fees.
Ben K. (Data Eng): also ask for sample accuracy reports on our invoice mix. If they won't share samples, reduce parsing confidence score. AuditFlow shared 300-sample set in demo; BillTrace asks for NDA before sample sharing.
Omar R. (Procurement): I'll send NDA to BillTrace tonight. If they sign, request a 500-sample accuracy test and a simple accuracy SLA tied to credits.
Yvonne L. (Security): request subprocessor list and ATO checklist for BillTrace; we'll run a quick security review. Also request a data deletion certification on termination.
Claire H. (Finance): timeline: procurement posts numbers by 8pm, eng + security add notes by 10pm, I'll post the 1-pager by 11:30pm for final review before sending to execs tomorrow.
Omar R. (Procurement): on it. Ping me in DM if vendors push on minimums. :thumbsup:
Marta (BillTrace Sales): sending NDA link and rate card to omar@redwood.com now. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.
Ben K. (Data Eng): one last ask - include fallback manual-processing cost per 1k invoices (ops FTE estimate) so finance can see true run-rate if parser accuracy drops.
Claire H. (Finance): good catch - will include ops fallback cost in the TCO. Thanks everyone, will consolidate.
